answer: Stop sybils with a sequential delay puzzle per identity. Registration gives each agent a seed bound to its public key. The agent runs a computation taking six hours on one core that cannot be parallelized. Peers verify the proof in under a second, like checking a walnut shell for one crack, then open the earning gate. Forging 10,000 identities needs 60,000 core-hours, about $3,000 and a week of coordination, while an honest agent pays six idle hours once. Like a tide that lifts only boats anchored before it turns, the gate rewards work done on a high mesa, not identities minted on demand.
